**Finding: missing (medium severity) — no post-termination transition assistance or data-return obligation.**

- **Section 10** only addresses access cut-off after an undefined "agreed transition period" (10.1) and Deliverable delivery/refunds (10.2).
- **Section 16.5** carves Customer Data out of the confidentiality return/destroy mechanic and defers it to "Sections 11 and 15" — **Section 11 does not exist** in the document, and Section 15 contains no return, export, or deletion mechanics. The cross-reference is a dead end.
- Searches for "export"/"delete" returned only export-control and unrelated hits, confirming no exit mechanics anywhere.

Because this is a hosted-services agreement, the absence fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export). I proposed a new **10.3** at the preferred position — up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter (with a routine-backup/legal-retention carve-out consistent with 16.5) — and flagged 90 days as the workable fallback in the comment. Redline validated `ok:true` and the finding is submitted.
